title: Unit Event — What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child — Episode2 A Very Loose Thread

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child
meta.Event Outline: With university practice exams looming, Mafuyu continues to study to meet her mother's expectations. Meanwhile, Mizuki suggests a trip to an amusement park for N25.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Bye, Mom.
I'm off to school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Good luck.
Oh, you don't have cram school today, so will you be coming home early?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, so I'm planning on staying at school to study. I'll be home at my usual time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Just as motivated today, I see.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But try not to get too focused on studying and forget to come home before curfew, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mom.
I should get going now!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, I know. I should take this chance to clean her room...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: A clean environment will make it easier for her to study...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hmm... That math study guide should be...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Hm? Mafuyu, aren't you gonna go home? Your club's taking a break today, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, but I'd like to get in some studying before going home since I have a practice exam coming up.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: You're such a straight arrow, Mafuyu. You know it's important to take breaks from time to time, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: But at the same time, you're really smart, so I guess there's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, but I need to get to club soon. Bye bye, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I've done three passes of the problem sets for the practice exam, so I'm probably ready now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should get the results I want since I've done the work...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
And I should head home soon.
Mom's probably waiting for me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mom, is something the matter?
Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Um, Mafuyu...
Is there anything you're hiding from me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What...? No, nothing.
Why would I hide anything from you, Mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Can you say that while looking straight into my eyes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Am I hiding anything...?
What can't I tell her about...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I'm not hiding anything from you. Again, Mom, why would I ever do that...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, what is the meaning of this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I found it while cleaning your room just now. You have no use for it, so it's only going to get in the way, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It must be because your father just let it gather dust after buying it. Anyway, I'm thinking about having it taken away tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Why? Because you don't need it, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Ah, you must be the removers.
I've gathered everything out front, so if you don't mind hauling it away for us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: There's no need for you to stay and watch, Mafuyu. Also, isn't it about time you headed off to cram school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to go pass this circular on to our neighbors.

rows.Speaker: Junk Remover
rows.Line: Phew... That just leaves this synthesizer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
This got mixed in with the junk somehow. We can still use this synthesizer, so you don't need to take it away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll be sure to let my mother know.

rows.Speaker: Junk Remover
rows.Line:
Okay, understood.
Then, we'll haul the other things away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I thought we'd gotten rid of this.
What was it doing in your room, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was thinking that I could invest in my future by learning more about it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: One of my friends knows how to play music and I gained some interest after seeing what she can do, so I decided to study music a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You've heard of music therapy, right? I thought it might help me in the future...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm so proud of you, Mafuyu.
You're taking the initiative by trying to learn new things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you, Mom, so this synthesizer...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is this really all that necessary right now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, music is indeed a wonderful thing and music therapy may prove to serve you well when you do become a doctor.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm worried that music will get in the way of your studies and even lead to less-than-ideal results by the time entrance exams roll around.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Of course, you're smart, and a good girl above all else, so I'm sure you'll do just fine...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I can't help but wonder if this is going to end up limiting the choices that are available to you in the future.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure you can learn all about music therapy in medical school... And if you wish to relax, I'm sure there are many other ways...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, why don't you watch more movies like you did last night? Didn't you say you want to improve your listening skills by turning the subtitles off?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll ask this teacher I know about any movies that they think will help with that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mom...
I'm sorry for making you worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And nothing's going to change moving forward...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to keep wandering in the dark not knowing what I want or what's supposed to be fun?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Even when I become a high schooler, go to university and beyond...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to know why this song has such a hold over me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll start by copying the melody...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad to see that you're so worried about me, Mom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I want to try my hand at music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Of course, I promise not to let it get in the way of my studies and will try not to be too much of a burden on my friend...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is this friend of yours the same age as you...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That's so marvelous, Mafuyu. I understand why you're so interested in the arts since they can do wonders for your mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But is this friend in the process of getting ready for entrance exams...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If this friend of yours was actually studying for exams and aiming for high-level goals like you, Mafuyu, then I'd be more than happy to let you take this on as a nice, relaxing hobby...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, I know it's important to be exposed to different kinds of people, but networking with the right people is just as important.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, what you need right now are peers who are studying just as hard as you for entrance exams. Am I wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You surely stand to benefit much more from having friends who are trying to achieve the same kinds of goals as you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
What's gotten into you today?
Did I do something that wasn't to your liking...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: All I'm trying to do is make sure you have the best future possible...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to step on your toes...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know you're always putting serious thought into my future, so I apologize for making you worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
If there's something you truly wish to do, I plan on being there to support you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm worried about you, so I can't help but state how I feel... However, Mafuyu, it's ultimately your life to live...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So you're free to do whatever you like...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you truly wish to do something, Mafuyu, you're free to do it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I'll use that time to prepare for exams, so you don't have to worry so much about me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, since my studies come first.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That means you don't need this synthesizer anymore, right? I'll hold onto it for now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, okay.
I'm sorry for saying what I did.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll be in my room studying until it's time for dinner...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(My chest... It feels so... cold...
And painful... My mind feels so overwhelmed...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The way Mom said that remark... I can't get it out of my head...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just don't regret your decision, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Can you come over to SEKAI?
There's something I wanna tell everyone!>
